svg.text: Arduino Pro Micro (5 V / 16 MHz) → 4164 / 41256 DRAM
Both parts seen from above. Every connection is a plain 1:1 wire.
STATUS LEDs — anode to +5 V, so a LOW pin lights the LED
Dashed wire = DRAM pin 1 (A8): needed only for the 41256; on a 4164 that pin is not connected and may be left open.
The DRAM is powered from the Pro Micro's VCC pin, so use a 5 V / 16 MHz board — a 3.3 V Pro Micro will not drive a 4164.
"18/A0" means Arduino pin 18, silkscreened A0 on the Pro Micro. Grey pads are unused.
